project.name: Primitive
release_notes: TimeMatch calendar mutations bind exact owned identities, separate first dispatch from read-only recovery, use strong CalDAV revision preconditions and immutable Graph ids, and refuse unsupported time precision before HTTP.

Availability remains timing-only and unknown on incomplete or unsupported provider answers. Google ownership uses the authenticated primary and secondary data owner; Graph recovery checks each candidate through documented individual property expansion.

Temporal owns exact civil availability across DST and dateline changes, checked instant ceiling and browser nanosecond parsing. TimeMatch adds typed organizer invitations and explicit credential-copy custody.
Firestore integer JSON reads preserve native signed integer nanoseconds and refuse floating-point fields before projection.
Instagram accepts the documented optional transient error field; focused Core and Exchange boundary defects and diagnostics are corrected.
